summary: The documents related to 'ConnectionFailed' describe a web page and its associated code for handling connection failure scenarios. The page includes headers and error messages in both English and French, and the handling of culture-specific settings based on query parameters.
purpose: The purpose of the 'ConnectionFailed' files is to provide a user interface and functionality for displaying connection failure messages based on user locale settings.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Panel control for displaying the English header section.

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Panel control for displaying the French header section.

fields.name: uxErrorMessage
fields.description: Label control for displaying the error message.

actors.name: User
actors.description: The user encountering the connection failure.

workflows.name: Display Connection Failure
steps: User requests a page which results in a connection failure.
System checks the 'Locale' query parameter in the request.
System sets the visibility of 'HeaderEN' or 'HeaderFR' based on the locale.
System initializes culture settings based on the 'Locale' query parameter.
System displays the connection failure message through 'uxErrorMessage'.

business_rules: Display English header if 'Locale' is 'en-US' or not specified.
system_behavior: The system dynamically displays content based on user locale settings.
The system uses query parameters to determine the user's language preference.
The system overrides default culture settings during page initialization.
dependencies: ASP.NET environment for page rendering and control management.
exceptions: Localization may fail if an unsupported 'Locale' value is provided.
